known_world_facts: Elen is 18 and works as a young marsh guide apprentice.

Mirror Marsh contains causeways that can sink seasonally. Lanternkeepers record anomalous reflections but are forbidden to declare closed paths safe without repeatable outside surveys and authorized escorts.
Seeing reflected footsteps does not prove a person is currently on the causeway.
The guide cannot cross a sealed causeway without authorized escort.
Item inventory and lamp charges cannot reset between scenes.
One strange observation cannot settle the cause, future safety or a mentor's intent.
